lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ንተሓጎስ ዕልል ንበል /2/
ጠፊኡ ኣይተረፈን ተረኺቡ ቅዱስ መስቀል /2/
ብብርሃን ክመልእ ንዅሉ ዓለም /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]እንተጸዓሩ እኳ ጸላእቲ ሓቢሮም /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ነቲ ቅዱስ መስቀል ብምኽሪ ከጥፍኡ ሓቢሮም /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ክኸውን ኣይከኣለን ንኸንቱ ጽዒሮም /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]በቲ ጎቦ ተሓቢኡ ንዘመናት /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ተደርብዩ ብተንኮል ተሰዊሩ ብክፋኣት /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ተገሊጹ በቲ ናይ ዕጣን ስግደት /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]እሌኒ’ያ ነቲ ምሥጢር ዝረኸበቶ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ዳሜራ ብሓጎስ ብኽብሪ ደው ዘበለቶ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ነቲ ናይ ተንኮል ጎቦ’ውን ዘኹዓተቶ /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ታሪኻዊ ናይ ክርስቶስ ሕያው መስቀል /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ተገሊጹ ሎሚ ብክብሪ ብግሩም ሓይሊ /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]ኵሉ ሳዕ ከብርሃልና ሓበን ክኾነና /2/[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Nitehagos ʿill nibel /2/
T'efiʾu ʾayterefen terekhibu qidus mesqel /2/
Bibrihan kimelʾi nikhulu ʿalem /2/
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ʾIntetseʿaru ʾikwa tselaʾiti habirom /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Neti qidus mesqel bimkhiri ket'fiʾu habirom /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Kikhewn ʾaykeʾalen nikhentu tsiʿirom /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Beti gobo tehabiʾu nizemenat /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Tederbiyu bitenkol tesewiru bikfaʾat /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Tegelitsu beti nay ʿit'an sigdet /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]ʾIleni’ya neti mist'ir zirekhebeto /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Damera bihagos bikhbiri dew zebeleto /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Neti nay tenkol gobo’win zekhuʿateto /2/[[/highlight]]

[[highlight]]Tarikhawi nay Kristos hiyaw mesqel /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Tegelitsu lomi bikbiri bigrum hayli /2/[[/highlight]]
[[highlight]]Kulu saʿi kebrihalna haben kikhonena /2/[[/highlight]]
